_comment: Beats are broadcast in order via the Palworld announce API.
Normal beats fire one per trigger (level-up, or the timer).
Beats marked burst:true fire immediately after the previous one,
separated only by burst_delay_seconds - once the antidote lands he
already knows, so the payoff is delivered as one volley rather than
dragged out over three separate triggers.
Edit freely. Keep lines short - in-game announcements flash past.

beats.text: Server notice: packet loss on the western route.
Cause traced to a courier job queued a long time ago.
The job never returned. It has been retrying ever since.
Inspected the payload. It is not data.
The courier is on a sled.
The girl lived. Good boy, Balto.
